mapper.sql: select share_id, share_code, kind, visitor_id, ref_id, coalesce(revoked, false) as revoked, coalesce(view_count, 0) as view_count, last_view_time, create_time, update_time from abr_share
mapper.select: insert into abr_share (share_code, kind, visitor_id, ref_id, options, render_count, revoked, create_time, update_time) values (#{shareCode}, #{kind}, #{visitorId}, #{refId}, cast(#{options} as jsonb), 1, false, now(), now()) on conflict (kind, visitor_id, ref_id) do update set share_code = case when abr_share.revoked then excluded.share_code else abr_share.share_code end, revoked = false, options = excluded.options, render_count = abr_share.render_count + 1, update_time = now() returning share_code
where kind = #{kind} and visitor_id = #{visitorId} and ref_id = #{refId}
mapper.update: update abr_share set revoked = true, update_time = now() where kind = #{kind} and visitor_id = #{visitorId} and ref_id = #{refId}
update abr_share set view_count = coalesce(view_count, 0) + 1, last_view_time = now() where share_id = #{shareId}
